errors.text_span: such as Inductive and Abductive reasoning for Davinci-003, ChatGPT, and BARD
errors.evidence: The description claims that the listed combinations are examples of categories with the lowest accuracy values (0.1-0.2). However, this is only true for BARD (with Inductive reasoning at ~0.1 and Abductive at ~0.2). The values for Davinci-003 and ChatGPT with these reasoning types are significantly higher, ranging from approximately 0.3 to 0.5.
